diagrams.scope: One provider-input OR answer-delivery attempt; repeat with a fresh manifest per purpose. Handlers and additive manifest storage are pending.
diagrams.legend: Solid: call; dashed: return. Guard is Workspace-owned; durable preparation and remote outcome writes occur outside it.

Revocation commits under the same guard after prior handoff completion/confirmed abort, then acknowledges success. Unknown remote lifecycle writes block affected handoffs. Already sent bytes cannot be recalled; a crash can leave outcome reconciliation pending.
